correctness.rationale: Every vertex triangle yields a positive integer cyclic-gap triple of sum 3m; its area is twice the product of three sines. The logarithm is strictly Schur-concave. The minimum-gap trichotomy exhausts all triples and majorizes every other candidate by the fourth pattern. The incomparable third/fourth difference expands exactly to 4cos(theta)sin^3(theta)>0. The first two gaps and equality counts are derived algebraically. Cartesian-coordinate exhaustive checks over 707434 vertex triangles confirm predicted shells for 26 finite orders but are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For all m>=3 it gives a complete sharp four-level near-optimal area landscape of vertex-supported inscribed triangles, including equality multiplicities. The third and fourth patterns are not comparable by majorization, yet have a universal exact cubic splitting, one asymptotic order smaller than the leading quadratic area losses. This is a motivated, uniform sharp-stability refinement of the familiar equilateral maximum, not a numerical result for an arbitrary finite polygon.
